title: A Proof of Sundaram's Bounded-Interval Higher Lie Positivity Conjecture
summary: For positive integers $n$ and $M$, Sundaram defined $ F_{n,M}=\sum_{\substack{d\mid n\\d\le M}} Lie_{n/d}[p_d] $ and conjectured that every coefficient in its Schur expansion is a nonnegative integer. We prove the conjecture. The power-sum expansion isolates the contribution of the identity class, and the proof divides Young diagrams at the intrinsic majority threshold. If the first row or first column contains more than half of the boxes, the Bernstein creation formula separates each rectangular-cycle character value into a hook constant and a remainder supported only on short cycles.
